title: A chain build plans its first draft in three parts at once, still with the visual review
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The chain's planner run is started with --parallel-pages 3 and the visual review, without the whole kit in its first message.
3 is a value the planner bench takes; a kit with fewer groups gets fewer parts.

tests: the chain's planner run plans its first draft in parts, with the visual review, reading the kit by tools
the number of parts is one the planner bench takes and plans in parts; a kit with fewer groups gets fewer parts
